labels.name: question
labels.rationale: Reporter asks whether they are doing it wrong; documented no_wrap and min_width options cover the layout asked for.

body:
This reads as a usage question, so it is labelled `question`. The table options `no_wrap` and `min_width` are documented here:

https://github.com/Textualize/rich/blob/master/docs/source/tables.rst

Setting `min_width` on the other columns stops them shrinking below the width they need, which may give the layout you want.

Related: #2890 reports `no_wrap` squashing columns below their minimum width.

For further questions, [Discussions](https://github.com/Textualize/rich/discussions) is the right place.

<sub>Automated first-response triage (rich-triage skill). A maintainer will review.</sub>
